- [ ] Verify bibliographic metadata, DOI, venue, and status
- [ ] Verify redistribution rights before committing PDF/TeX
- [ ] Acquire lawful source or record precise access limitation
- [ ] Read methods, results, limitations and supplementary material
- [ ] Create or revise `literature-reviews/<category>/<paper-id>.md`
- [ ] Add competing/null evidence and alternative interpretations
- [ ] Link mechanisms, decisions, tests and implementation effects
- [ ] Validate references and mark evidence-access level
